_readme: QualiLens model catalog. Edit THIS file when a provider retires or
releases a model — no code changes needed. The first model that
matches default_model is preselected in the wizard; users can always
type a custom model id there as well. Verify your edits with the
'Check models' button in Settings, which compares this catalog against
the provider's live model list using your API key (free, no tokens).
Edits take effect on the next page load — no restart needed. Caveat:
some vendors serve alias ids (e.g. '-latest') that work in chat but may
not appear in their list endpoint; a working model marked ✗ may simply
be an alias — confirm with the Test button before removing it.
pricing_usd_per_mtok feeds only the pre-run cost estimate. It is either
[input, output] per million tokens for the whole provider, or an object
{"default": [in, out], "<model id>": [in, out], ...} so the estimate
can price the model the project chose; a model with no entry uses the
default. Prices are the authors' reading of public list prices at the
time of editing and are not guaranteed — check the provider's page.
If this file is missing or invalid, the app falls back to defaults
compiled into backend/app/llm.py. An in-app update replaces this file;
an edited copy is saved as <data folder>/models.json.previous so your
edits can be reapplied.
